keyRewards: Friendly: Skyforged / Gustwoven / Windraveled / Stormsewn starter armour patterns (wrist, hands, waist, feet; Azure and Cloudy colours)

name: Azeroth Commerce Authority
where: Three Corners, Redridge Mountains (crates to Marcy Baker; rewards from Tamelyn Aldridge; mount from Huey Sunnydale)
howToRaise: Fill Waylaid Crates (world drops or Auction House) with one listed item and turn them in for rep plus Merchant's Favor; also complete Craftsman's Writs that drop from mobs. Your first crate gives a Shipping Label quest.
keyRewards: Honored: Advertising License Application (Tradeskill Signpost toy quest) - 1,200 Merchant's Favor
Exalted: Reins of the Pack Kodo (mount) - 6,000 MF
Exalted: Azeroth Commerce Authority Tabard - 200 MF
Profession Certification titles at 300 skill - 1,000 MF
Friendly/Honored: profession recipes such as Schematic: Gnomish Poultryizer
